purpose: Final cold-eye mapping of 12 player-flow hypotheses to existing executed paired fixtures. This is not 12 newly authored RED tests. New test execution belongs to retained earlier stages; no redundant tests were written or run for this final map.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A player enters ordinary fallow countryside: can the encounter add bonus actors or claim a late matching substitute?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: One complete original hostile roll and one exact original Magpie fund the pair; a missing source/blueprint refuses the entire replacement. The intentional loss of that Magpie’s later trader stock is documented.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The prey disappears behind a real tree: does the hunter still know its hidden current coordinates?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: A remembered route is invariant under hidden quarry relocation and full saved replacement; real opaque cover changes the interleaved result. Both covered and open controls surviving is honest, not a promised winner.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A nearby death shakes the grazer and its hunter returns: will effect-owned pacing ignore visible danger?
hypotheses.classification: Confirmed stage3 behavior defect; retained RED→GREEN
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Only this exact nearby visible pair can substitute one real flight step. Witnessed and its duration owner remain, tick normally and remove their own goals. Far/hidden/unpaired/spent controls keep ordinary pacing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The player interrupts, recruits, calms or gives work: can local hunting overrule combat or spend a second action?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Ordinary current threat, party/follow, Calm, conversation and explicit work remain authoritative; a successful local action does not push a second attacking child.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A real hunt kills the grazer: can feeding synthesize a body, extra meat or a second ordinary loot roll?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: The actual own-kill receipt is used only when the unchanged 70% roll creates its real body. Both sides of 69/70 and independent ordinary Beast death drops are tested; feeding creates no reward.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The player takes or moves a feeding corpse, or a callback replaces it: can a matching decoy be consumed?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Moving, carrying, transferring, changing source/killer IDs and replacement each invalidate the exact claim. A copied provenance decoy is not the fresh native creation receipt.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The player leaves, saves and returns during pursuit or feeding: can budgets refill, removed owners reappear or aliases split?
hypotheses.classification: Cross-system saved graph coverage, already executed
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Actual generated pair state/absence survives cache and full reload; staged feeding at each progress value preserves the exact corpse and finite claim. These are fixtures, not substitutes for native keyboard save evidence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A player examines a paused hunter or watches feeding: can the text or animation claim an action that did not happen?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Two paid progress actions emit two valid current-owner Interact gestures; consumption emits none after the target leaves. Higher-priority pauses suppress active feeding prose. Inspection changes no state and promises no Harvest.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A visible hunter is hidden, transferred, killed, picked up or reconstructed: can it borrow a stale model?
hypotheses.classification: Actual imported art/current-owner coverage, already executed
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Current-owner and source guards govern the imported body/remains; ongoing hunt configuration does not gate healthy body appearance. Pickup/drop removes/restores the actual ground owner. Existing animal forms remain unchanged.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A generation callback or later stock/placement step changes an actor or route: can rollback erase that change or leave half a pair?
hypotheses.classification: Confirmed callback hardening plus cross-system controls, already executed
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Snapshot proofs revalidate all already-created owners after each authority callback. Rollback restores only unchanged owned graphs; foreign movement/blockers survive. Later stock of other Magpies is allowed, later blockers of accepted anchors are rejected.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The exact prey is removed, recruited, dead or has a foreign rebound role: can pursuit retarget a lookalike or corrupt another actor?
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Cold unbound brains may configure, foreign zones may not; live actions require exact current owners. Invalidated pairs never retarget a matching grazer, and terminal cleanup modifies only the owned reciprocal part.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two grazers flee repeatedly, including a movement callback or saved reload: can retained search memory alter decisions or create recurring turn-path garbage?
hypotheses.classification: Confirmed stage4/5 allocation correction plus semantic controls
hypotheses.contractAndCounter: Per-owner value-only buffers clear before movement callbacks. Traversal/ties, hidden-history invariance, changed blockers, two-owner isolation and save reconstruction remain equal. Actual calibrated native event counts fall to one for both measured paths; all defined phases remain accepted and malformed values rejected.
